# Privacy Policy

## 1\. Introduction

Aviso, Inc. ( **“Aviso,” “we,” “our,” and/or “us”**) is committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring you have a positive experience on our website and in using our products and services (collectively “Products”). This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and retain information from users of our Products (“Users”). Please read this Privacy Policy carefully to understand how we handle your Personal Data. Where we rely on your consent to process Personal Data, we will ask for it separately, and you may withdraw it at any time. Beyond this Privacy Policy, your use of our Products is also subject to our [Terms of Service](https://www.aviso.com/terms-of-service).

This policy covers the Aviso website and is applicable worldwide. If you give us Personal Data, we will treat it according to this policy.

### Scope of this Policy and Aviso’s Role

This Privacy Policy applies to Personal Data that Aviso processes as a controller, including data collected through our website (www.aviso.com), our marketing and sales activities, events and webinars, support communications, and job applications.

When our business customers use the Aviso platform, they may upload or connect data such as CRM records, communication metadata, revenue and pipeline data, and information about their sales personnel (“Customer Data”). Aviso processes Customer Data as a processor (or “service provider”) on behalf of, and under the instructions of, the relevant customer, in accordance with our agreement with that customer, including our Data Processing Agreement. The customer’s own privacy notice governs Customer Data, and the customer is responsible for responding to individuals’ requests concerning it. If your Personal Data is included in Customer Data, please contact the relevant customer directly. If you contact us, we will refer your request to that customer and assist them as required by our agreement.

## 2\. Information We Collect

When you interact with our Products, we collect information that, alone or in combination with other information, could be used to identify you ( **“Personal Data”**). “Personal Data” means any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person, and may include, but is not limited to, name, email address, postal or other physical address, credit or debit card number, title, and information generated from use of our Products.

### A. Information You Provide to Us

- **Account Registration.** When you sign up for an account or register to use certain Product features, we ask you for information such as your name, email address, billing information, and phone number.

- **Orders and Transactions.** When you place an order or transaction, we collect information necessary to process that order, including billing and shipping details and payment information.

- **Support and Communications.** When you request support or contact us directly, we may receive additional information such as your name, email address, company name, job title, and the contents of any messages or attachments you send us.

- **Registrations and Participation.** When you register for a seminar, webinar, membership program, newsletter subscription, online survey, sweepstakes, or other promotional activities, we collect the information you provide.

- **Careers.** If you apply for a job with us, we collect your contact information and resume content, including education and employment experience.

- **Payment Information.** If you make a payment, your payment-related information (such as credit card or other financial information) is collected by our third-party payment processor on our behalf.


### B. Information We Collect When You Use Our Products

- **Device and Usage Information.** We automatically collect information about the device and software you use to access our Products, including IP address (which may provide general location information), device type, operating system and version, web browser type and version, and certain device or session identifiers. We also collect information about your interactions with our Products, such as the pages you view, features you use, referrer information, and dates and times of your visits.

- **Product Usage Data.** When our customers use the Aviso platform, we collect technical and usage information, such as authentication and access logs, performance metrics, and feature usage, to operate, secure, and improve the platform. Other data processed within the platform on our customers’ behalf, such as communication metadata, account and customer references, revenue and pipeline data, and sales personnel identifiers, is Customer Data, handled as described in “ [Scope of this Policy and Aviso’s Role](https://www.aviso.com/privacy-policy#scope-and-role).”

- **Reports and Generated Data.** We collect information generated from use of our Products to provide reports and analytics to you and to improve our services.

- **Information from Cookies and Other Tracking Technologies.** We and our third-party partners collect information about your activities on our Products using cookies, web beacons, pixel tags, and similar tracking technologies. Please read the **“** [**Cookies**](https://www.aviso.com/privacy-policy#cookies) **”** section below for more information.

- **Server Log Files.** Our website and Products automatically collect and store information that your browser transmits to us as part of standard server log files. This includes your IP address, the time of the server request, the referrer URL, the method used to access the page, the returned HTTP status code, and the processing time to return the response. This data is used for security, analytics, and performance monitoring only and is not merged with other data sources. We reserve the right to review this data at a later date where there is concrete evidence of unlawful use.


### C. Information We Collect from Third Parties

We also receive Personal Data about you from third parties, which we may combine with the information we collect directly. These sources include:

- **Lead Enrichment Data.** Firmographic and professional information (such as company, role, and industry) obtained from data providers, which we use to qualify and contextualize business leads.

- **Advertising and Conversion Data.** Information from advertising platforms about your interactions with our advertisements and the resulting conversions.

- **Publicly Available and Professional Network Information.** Information from professional networks and other publicly available sources, where the collection and use of such information is lawful.


## 3\. Cookies

Like many websites, Aviso uses cookies, web beacons (also known as pixels or tags), and similar technologies. Cookies are small text files placed on your device that allow our website to function, remember your preferences, and help us and our partners understand how the website is used and measure the effectiveness of our advertising.

Cookies and similar technologies may collect online identifiers (such as cookie IDs and device identifiers), your IP address, and information about your browsing activity on our website. Under data protection laws such as the GDPR, this information may constitute Personal Data. If you register or submit a form on our website, we may link this information to the details you provide, to understand how visitors use our website and to improve its content and navigation. Where consent is required, we do this only for cookies you have accepted.

Web beacons are small graphic images or code snippets embedded in our web pages or emails that allow us or our partners to record that a page was viewed or an email was opened. Web beacons used for analytics or advertising are subject to the same consent choices as non-essential cookies. Rejecting non-essential cookies through our cookie banner prevents the non-essential tools listed in this section from loading.\]

Strictly necessary cookies are required for the website to function and cannot be switched off through our cookie banner. All other categories are used only with your consent where required by law. You can also set your browser to block cookies or alert you when cookies are being sent. If you do, some website functionality, particularly pages that require login, may not work.

### 3.2 How to manage cookie preferences

When you first visit the Website, a cookie consent banner is displayed. You can:

- Accept all cookies.

- Reject all non-essential cookies.

- Customize your preferences by category (Functional, Analytics, Advertising).


You can change your preferences at any time by clicking the “Cookie Preferences” link in the Website footer. You can also configure your browser to refuse cookies or alert you when cookies are being sent. Note that if you disable cookies, some Website functionality may be impaired.

**We honour the Global Privacy Control (GPC) browser signal as an opt-out of “sale” and “sharing” of personal information for residents of U.S. states that recognize this signal.**

## 4\. How We Use the Information We Collect

We will use your Personal Data only in accordance with this Privacy Policy. We use the information we collect to:

- Process your orders and deliver the products and services that you have ordered.

- Provide reports based on information collected from use of our Products.

- Keep you up to date on the latest Product announcements, software updates, upgrades, system enhancements, special offers, and other information — you can edit your marketing preferences at any time as described below.

- Provide support and assistance for our Products.

- Provide the ability to create personal profile areas and view protected content.

- Contact you and provide shipping and billing information.

- Provide customer feedback and support.

- Administer contests, sweepstakes, or other marketing or promotional activities.

- Conduct questionnaires and surveys to improve our products and services. Your completion of any questionnaire is voluntary.

- Support recruitment inquiries.

- Personalize newsletters and our website to your preferences, including providing information on products and services that may be of interest to you.

- Generate anonymized or aggregate data containing only de-identified, non-Personal Data, which we may use for any lawful purpose such as publishing reports.

- Meet contract obligations.

- Find and prevent fraud, abuse and respond to trust and safety issues that may arise.

- For compliance purposes, including enforcing our Terms of Service or other legal rights, or as maybe required by applicable laws and regulations or requested by any judicial process or governmental agency.

- For other purposes for which we provide specific notice at the time the information is collected.


If we ever intend to use your Personal Data in any manner not consistent with this Privacy Policy, we will inform you of our intended use prior to, or at the time at which, we collect such information.

## 5\. Lawful Basis to Process Personal Data

The legal basis for which we collect and use the Personal Data described above depends on what the information is and why we collected it. The bases upon which we rely include:

- **Contract.** If you decide to use our Products, we will process your Personal Data to perform our contract with you.

- **Legitimate Interests.** “Legitimate interests” means our interests in conducting our business and delivering the best Products and services to you. We will not use your Personal Data for activities where the impact on you overrides our interests, unless we have your consent or those activities are otherwise required or permitted by law. Examples include improving our Products and services; enabling us to fight against fraud; and responding to your inquiries.

- **Legal Obligations.** We may need to use your Personal Data to comply with our legal obligations or to protect the rights of other users, for example to comply with regulatory reporting, tax, and accounting obligations.

- **Consent.** We may also process your Personal Data based on your consent in certain circumstances, such as when you sign up for direct marketing communications. You may withdraw your consent at any time by contacting us.

## 6\. How We Disclose the Information We Collect

We do not sell or rent your Personal Data to third parties for marketing purposes or monetary consideration unless you have granted us permission to do so.

- **Within Aviso.** We share Personal Data with our affiliate Aviso Software India LLP (India), which provides product engineering, technical support services to Aviso, Inc., under an intra-group agreement as described in “ [Data Transfers](https://www.aviso.com/privacy-policy#data-transfers)” below.

- **Processors, Vendors, and Service Providers.** We share Personal Data with service providers that process it on our behalf to help us operate our website and Products, including cloud hosting, analytics, CRM, email delivery, customer support, payment processing, and event or webinar registration. We provide them only with the Personal Data necessary to perform their services, and they may use it only on our instructions and for no other purpose. We engage only providers that offer sufficient guarantees of appropriate technical and organisational measures, and each engagement is governed by a written data processing agreement consistent with Article 28 of the GDPR.

- **As Required by Law and Similar Disclosures.** We may respond to subpoenas, court orders, or legal process by disclosing Personal Data and other related information if necessary. We also may establish or exercise our legal rights or defend against legal claims. We may also collect and share Personal Data to investigate, prevent, or take action regarding illegal activities, suspected fraud, situations involving potential threats to the physical safety of any person, violations of Aviso’s Terms of Service, or as otherwise required by law.

- **Professional Advisors.** We may share Personal Data with our professional advisors, including lawyers, auditors, and accountants, who are bound by obligations of confidentiality, where necessary to obtain professional advice or to establish, exercise, or defend legal rights.

- **Merger, Sale, or Other Asset Transfers.** We may transfer your information to service providers, advisors, potential transactional partners, or other third parties in connection with the consideration, negotiation, or completion of a corporate transaction in which we are acquired by or merged with another company, or we sell, liquidate, or transfer all or a portion of our assets. The use of your information following any of these events will be governed by the provisions of this Privacy Policy in effect at the time the applicable information was collected.

- **Consent.** We may also disclose your information with your permission.


We will ask for your consent before we use or share your information for any purpose other than the reason you provided it or as otherwise provided by this policy. A current list of vendors, service providers, sub-processors, business partners who process personal data is available on request.

Some of the third-party tools listed in [Section 3](https://www.aviso.com/privacy-policy#cookies) may constitute a “sale” or “sharing” of personal information under the CCPA/CPRA and similar U.S. state laws, even though we receive no monetary consideration. Specifically, the use of advertising cookies (Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, Reddit) and certain visitor identification tools may share identifiers with those providers for cross-context behavioural advertising. California, Colorado, Connecticut, Virginia, Texas, and other state residents have the right to opt out of this sharing using the “Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information” link in the Website footer or by enabling Global Privacy Control in their browser.

## 7\. Security of Personal Data

Aviso is committed to protecting the Personal Data you share with us. We take reasonable precautions to protect Personal Data in our possession from loss, misuse, unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, and destruction. We follow generally accepted industry standards to protect the Personal Data submitted to us, both during transmission and once we receive it. These standards include appropriate technical and organisational measures, such as encryption of data in transit and at rest, access controls, and security monitoring. Our information security management system is certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022, and our controls are independently audited annually under the SOC 2 Type II framework.

Personal Data transmitted to and from our website and Products is protected using Transport Layer Security (TLS) encryption. Payment card information is collected and processed directly by our third-party payment processor. However, no method of transmission over the Internet or method of electronic storage is 100% secure. While we use commercially reasonable measures to protect Personal Data, we cannot guarantee its absolute security.

## 8\. Data Retention

We take measures to delete Personal Data or keep it in a form that does not permit identifying you when this information is no longer necessary for the purposes for which we process it, unless we need to retain certain information as required by law, including to comply with tax requirements, or for as long as reasonably necessary to meet regulatory requirements, resolve disputes, prevent fraud and abuse, or enforce our terms and conditions.

We may need to retain some Personal Data for the period necessary for legal proceedings, legal requirements, or for settling your account. When determining the specific retention period, we consider various criteria such as the type of service provided to you, the nature and length of our relationship with you, and mandatory retention periods provided by law and the relevant statute of limitations.

## 9\. Your Choices

- **Accessing and Updating Personal Data.** If you believe Aviso is in possession of Personal Data that you want modified or deleted, you may contact us using one of the methods specified in the **“** [**Contact Us**](https://www.aviso.com/privacy-policy#contact-us) **”** section below.

- **Unsubscribing from Marketing Communications.** You can unsubscribe from our promotional emails via the link provided in those emails or by sending an email with your name and email address to unsubscribe@aviso.com. Even if you opt out of receiving promotional email messages, you will continue to receive administrative messages from us.

- **Cookies.** You can manage your cookie preferences via your browser settings or visit the Cookies section above for more information.


## 10\. Your Rights

Depending on where you reside, you may have certain rights under applicable data privacy laws. The rights available to you are summarised below according to your jurisdiction.

### Rights for EU, EEA, UK, and Swiss Residents

If you are in the European Union, European Economic Area (EEA), United Kingdom, or Switzerland, you have the following legal rights:

- **Right of Access.** You may ask us to confirm whether we are processing your Personal Data and, if so, to provide you with a copy of that Personal Data along with certain other details, including a machine-readable copy.

- **Right to Rectification.** If your Personal Data is inaccurate or incomplete, you are entitled to ask that we correct or complete it. If we shared your Personal Data with others, we would inform them about the correction where possible.

- **Right to Erasure.** You may ask us to erase your Personal Data in some circumstances, such as where we no longer need it or you withdraw your consent (where applicable). If we shared your data with others, we would alert them to the need for erasure where possible.

- **Right to Restrict Processing.** You may ask us to restrict or ‘block’ the processing of your Personal Data in certain circumstances, such as where you contest the accuracy of the data or object to our processing it. We will inform you before we lift any restriction on processing.

- **Right to Data Portability.** You have the right to obtain your Personal Data from us in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format. You may reuse it elsewhere.

- **Right to Object.** You may ask us at any time to stop processing your Personal Data:


1) if we are relying on a legitimate interest to process your Personal Data — unless we demonstrate compelling legitimate grounds for the processing; or

2) if we are processing your Personal Data for direct marketing.

- **Rights in Relation to Automated Decision-Making and Profiling.** You have the right to be free from decisions based solely on automated processing of your Personal Data, including profiling, unless this is necessary for a contract between you and us or you provide your explicit consent.

- **Right to Withdraw Consent.** If we rely on your consent to process your Personal Data, you have the right to withdraw that consent at any time. This will not affect any processing of your data that has already taken place.

- **Right to Lodge a Complaint.** If you have a concern about our privacy practices, you can report it to the data protection authority authorized to hear those concerns in your country of residence, place of work, or where an incident took place. We would, however, appreciate the chance to deal with your concerns before you approach a supervisory authority, so please contact us in the first instance.


You may exercise these rights by contacting us using the methods specified in the “ [Contact Us](https://www.aviso.com/privacy-policy#contact-us)” section below.

**Provision of Personal Data.** Unless otherwise agreed between you and Aviso, you are not under a statutory or contractual obligation to provide Personal Data to us. Where certain Personal Data is required to enter into or perform a contract with you, or to deliver a specific Product or service you have requested, we will tell you at the point of collection and explain the consequences of not providing it. In all other cases, you will not be disadvantaged by choosing not to provide Personal Data, although some features of our Products may be unavailable as a result.

### Privacy Rights for U.S. State Residents

If you are a resident of California, Colorado, Connecticut, Virginia, Texas, Utah, or another U.S. state with a comprehensive consumer privacy law, you may have the following rights, subject to certain exceptions:

- **Right to Know.** You may request to know what Personal Data we collect, use, share, or sell about you.

- **Right to Delete.** You may request that we delete the Personal Data we hold about you.

- **Right to Correct.** You may request that we correct inaccurate Personal Data we hold about you.

- **Right to Opt Out of Sale or Sharing.** You may opt out of the “sale” or “sharing” of your Personal Data, including for cross-context behavioural advertising.

- **Right to Opt Out of Targeted Advertising.** You may opt out of processing of your Personal Data for purposes of targeted advertising.

- **Right to Limit Use of Sensitive Personal Information.** Where applicable, you may limit our use and disclosure of sensitive Personal Data to specified permitted purposes.

- **Right to Non-Discrimination.** We will not discriminate against you for exercising any of your privacy rights.


To exercise any of these rights, email privacy@Aviso.com or use the request forms linked in the Website footer. You may also opt out of “sale,” “sharing,” and targeted advertising using the “Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information” link in the Website footer or by enabling the Global Privacy Control (GPC) signal in your browser. You may use an authorised agent to submit a request on your behalf, subject to verification. We will verify your identity before responding and will respond within the timeframes required by applicable law.

**How to Submit a Verifiable Request.** To help us process your request, please provide your full name, contact information, and sufficient details to identify the Personal Data related to your request. If submitting through an authorised agent, a signed authorisation document must also be provided. We will review and respond to your request within the applicable timeframes set out in the “ [Contact Us](https://www.aviso.com/privacy-policy#contact-us)” section below.

**Appeals.** If we decline to take action on your request, you may appeal our decision by emailing privacy@aviso.com with the subject line “Privacy Request Appeal” within 45 days of our response. We will respond to your appeal in writing within the period required by applicable law (generally 45 or 60 days), including an explanation of our decision. If your appeal is denied, you may contact the Attorney General of your state of residence.

## 11\. Data Transfers

Aviso, Inc. is based in the United States (“U.S.”) and processes Personal Data in the U.S. If you are accessing our Products from outside the U.S., we may transfer Personal Data to countries with different data protection standards.

Our affiliate, Aviso Software India LLP, located in India, supports Aviso, Inc. with product engineering, technical support and may access Personal Data for those purposes. Where Personal Data received in reliance on the Data Privacy Framework is transferred onward to Aviso Software India LLP, we do so under a written intra-group agreement that requires it to process the data only for limited and specified purposes and to provide at least the same level of protection as the DPF Principles. Aviso, Inc. remains responsible under the DPF Principles for that processing. Where Personal Data is transferred directly from the EEA, UK or Switzerland to India, we rely on the European Commission’s Standard Contractual Clauses, together with the UK International Data Transfer Addendum and the amendments required by the Swiss FADP, as applicable.

### 11.1 EU-U.S., UK, and Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Framework

Aviso complies with the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, the UK Extension to the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, and the Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Framework as set forth by the U.S. Department of Commerce regarding the collection, use, and retention of Personal Data transferred from the European Union, United Kingdom, or Switzerland to the United States. Aviso has certified to the U.S. Department of Commerce that it adheres to the Data Privacy Framework Principles with regard to the processing of Personal Data received from the European Union, the United Kingdom, and from Switzerland in reliance on the respective Data Privacy Frameworks. If there is any conflict between the terms in this Privacy Policy and the Data Privacy Framework Principles, the Data Privacy Framework Principles shall govern. To learn more about the Data Privacy Framework program and to view our certification, please visit [https://www.dataprivacyframework.gov/](https://www.dataprivacyframework.gov/).

Aviso’s DPF certification does not cover human resources data. Personal Data of job applicants located in the EEA, UK or Switzerland is not transferred in reliance on the DPF and is instead protected by the Standard Contractual Clauses.

Aviso acknowledges that it is subject to the investigatory and enforcement powers of the Federal Trade Commission (FTC). We may also disclose Personal Data in response to lawful requests by public authorities, including to meet national security or law enforcement requirements.

### 11.2 DPF Individual Rights

Pursuant to the DPF Program, EU, UK, and Swiss individuals have the right to obtain our confirmation of whether we maintain personal information relating to you in the United States. Upon request, we will provide you with access to the personal information that we hold about you. You may also correct, amend, or delete the personal information we hold about you. An individual who seeks access, or who seeks to correct, amend, or delete inaccurate data transferred to the United States in reliance on the DPF Program should direct their query to privacy@aviso.com. If requested to remove data, we will respond within a reasonable timeframe.

We will provide an individual opt-out choice — or opt-in for sensitive data — before we share your data with third parties other than our agents, or before we use it for a purpose other than for which it was originally collected or subsequently authorized. To request to limit the use and disclosure of your personal information, please submit a written request to privacy@aviso.com.

Where we transfer your personal data to third-party service providers who perform services for us or on our behalf, we are responsible for the processing of that data by them and shall remain liable if they process your personal data in a manner inconsistent with the DPF Principles, unless we prove that we are not responsible for the event giving rise to the damage.

### 11.3 Dispute Resolution

Individuals with questions or complaints about our compliance with the Data Privacy Framework may contact us at [privacy@Aviso.com](mailto:privacy@aviso.com). Unresolved concerns may be referred at no cost to BBB National Programs, a U.S.-based independent dispute resolution mechanism, via [https://bbbprograms.org/programs/all-programs/dpf-consumers/ProcessForConsumers](https://bbbprograms.org/programs/all-programs/dpf-consumers/ProcessForConsumers).

Under certain conditions, individuals have the right to invoke binding arbitration. Aviso is obligated to arbitrate claims and follow the terms set forth in Annex I of the Data Privacy Framework Principles. For more information about binding arbitration under Annex I of the DPF, please visit [https://www.dataprivacyframework.gov/framework-article/ANNEX-I-introduction](https://www.dataprivacyframework.gov/framework-article/ANNEX-I-introduction).

### 11.4 Other Transfer Mechanisms

We take measures to ensure that Personal Data remains protected in accordance with this Privacy Policy and applicable data protection laws. In particular, for data transfers outside Europe, we will rely on:

1) the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, the UK Extension to the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, and the Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Framework;

2) an EU Commission, UK Secretary of State, or Swiss government adequacy decision;

- Know the sites your children are visiting and which sites are appropriate.

- Look for website privacy policies and know how your child’s information is treated.
